payload.summary:
## profiles (`/api/security/app`)

Profiles — collections of roles that simplify permission assignment. Instead of assigning individual roles to users, assign a Profile that bundles multiple roles. Profiles are scoped to an application. A profile can be the 'defaultProfile' assigned automatically to new users. Profiles can be restricted to specific clients within the hierarchy. The 'arrangement' field stores UI layout preferences for the profile (e.g. sidebar structure).

**Schema fields:**
  - `appId`: ULong — application this profile belongs to
  - `clientId`: ULong — owning client ID
  - `name`: string — profile name
  - `title`: string — display title
  - `description`: string — profile description
  - `defaultProfile`: boolean — if true, auto-assigned to new users in this app
  - `rootProfileId`: ULong — ID of the root/parent profile (for profile inheritance)
  - `arrangement`: Map<String, Object> — UI layout configuration (sidebar, menu structure)

**Custom endpoints:**
  - `POST /api/security/app/profiles` — Create a new profile with selected roles — body: {name: string, title: string, description: string, appId: ULong, roleIds: [ULong]}
  - `PUT /api/security/app/profiles` — Update a profile — can change roles, name, description — body: {id: ULong, name: string, title: string, description: string, appId: ULong, roleIds: [ULong]}
  - `GET /api/security/app/profiles/{id}` — Get profile by ID with role details
  - `DELETE /api/security/app/profiles/{id}` — Delete a profile — removes profile assignments from all users
  - `GET /api/security/app/{appId}/profiles?page=int&size=int` — List profiles for an application (paginated)
  - `POST /api/security/app/profiles/{id}/restrictClient/{clientId}` — Restrict profile visibility to a specific client — only users of that client can be assigned this profile

## KB

Overview

**Section**: overview

**Content**:
Taskmate is a collaborative
task-management and project-tracking application designed for teams to organize work, track progress, and communicate as
ynchronously. Built on the Modlix platform with a blue/
neutral productivity theme, Taskmate allows users to create projects, organize tasks into a
four-column Kanban board (BACKLOG → IN_PROGRESS → REVIEW → DONE), assign work to team members, set
due dates, and leave threaded comments on tasks. The app supports three role t
iers—admin (full access), owner (project creation + management), and member (task execution)
—with role-gated storage CRUD operations and a self
-service customer signup flow. Core workflows include task assignment with auto
-generated comments, task completion with archival, and project-

scoped task filtering.

**Status**: ✅ Committed (

version 2)

---

## KB Decisions Log

**Entry 1: Theme Selection

(Blue/Neutral Productivity Palette)**
- **Decision**: Created `taskmat
etheme` with primary=#3B82F6
(bright productive blue), success=#84CC16 (green
), error=#DC2626 (red), warning=#F59E0B (amber), plus neutral

grays for hierarchy.
- **Rationale**: Blue conveys trust and productivity (standard
in SaaS task managers like Asana, J
ira); green/red/amber for status signals align with international
conventions (go/stop/caution). Neutral grays reduce cognitive load when

scanning task lists.

**Entry 2: Comment Auto-Generation on Task Mutations

**
- **Decision**: Instead of requiring manual "notes" fields, the `assignTask
WithNotification` and `completeTaskAndArchive` server functions write system-generated comments (e.g., "Assigned to alice
@example.com", "Task completed at 2025-01-15 14:30

UTC") to the Comment storage.
- **Rationale**: Creates an immutable audit trail without
cluttering the UI. Users see WHO did WHAT and WHEN in one
place (the comments panel). Alternative (metadata fields
on Task) would require schema changes for each new event type
; comment-based approach is infinitely extensible. Downside: requires
careful permission gating so system comments can't be edited

/deleted.

**Status**: ✅ Committed (version 2)

now live and will serve as the reference for future work on task
mate. The overview frames the product scope and the decisions log captures the rat
ionale behind the theme + the comment audit-trail pattern for
future builders.
